decision_record.calculation: Fixture: book $10,000, held ETH value $9,960 at target ~$9,999.92 (drift $39.92 < $50 band). Control: 1 dust buy of ~$39.92. Treatment: 0 intents. Full-exit and flat-entry fixtures unchanged (batch-1 blockers).
decision_record.comparison: Rebalance-on-any-drift (>$0.01) vs fee-aware no-trade band: at 0.2% one-way fee, an adjustment below 0.5% of book pays 2.5x its own size in fees over a round trip to correct <0.5% of exposure.
decision_record.experiment: Fixture A/B above + switch-OFF restoration showing the dust trade itself (<$50 notional). Blockers: TestNativeEthDeadband.
decision_record.mechanism: Execution cost: daily evaluation + price jitter around the target generated a dust trade nearly every session while invested. Treatment refuses drift adjustments within 0.5% of book while invested; initial entries and full SMA200 exits are never banded.
decision_record.transfer: SMA200 trend allocation ETH 100%: the transfer is the trend premium; it is consumed at the margin by the sleeve's own 0.2% rebalance fee when it trades dust.

switch: extra.enh_aster_native_eth_sma200.deadband default ON; OFF restores any-drift rebalance exactly
